_comment: office paragraph indents (text-features.json `a-center-indent`): every line wraps inside its own indents — leftIndent (marL), first-line indent, rightIndent — and is aligned between them. vyaz used to wrap at the full box width and push indented lines past the box.

children.text: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while a frame measures every line box and decides where each word wraps inside the given rectangle.
